artifacts.name: xau_usd_daily_ohlc
artifacts.notes: Daily OHLC merged from multiple public sources. Coverage is strongest from 2006-04-25 to 2026-01-09 and 2026-03-25 to the latest recent window. See source column for provenance.

artifacts.name: xau_usd_monthly_close
artifacts.notes: Complete monthly close series from Macrotrends through the latest published month.

artifacts.name: GVZ
artifacts.notes: Daily close series merged with Cboe official history preferred and Yahoo Finance used only for older backfill if needed.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_ETF_HOLDINGS_WEEKLY
artifacts.notes: Weekly global physically backed gold ETF holdings aggregated across North America, Europe, Asia, and Other; units are tonnes.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_ETF_HOLDINGS_MONTHLY
artifacts.notes: Monthly global physically backed gold ETF holdings aggregated across North America, Europe, Asia, and Other; units are tonnes.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_ETF_NET_FLOWS_WEEKLY
artifacts.notes: Weekly global gold ETF net flows aggregated across regions using WGC tonnage flow series.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_ETF_NET_FLOWS_MONTHLY
artifacts.notes: Monthly global gold ETF net flows aggregated across regions using WGC tonnage flow series.

artifacts.name: GLD_TOTAL_HOLDINGS_TONNES
artifacts.notes: Daily GLD trust gold holdings in tonnes from the official SPDR Gold Shares historical archive.

artifacts.name: GLD_DAILY_SHARE_VOLUME
artifacts.notes: Daily GLD exchange share volume from the official SPDR Gold Shares historical archive.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_MINE_PRODUCTION_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly global mine production from the World Gold Council supply and demand dataset; units are tonnes.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_MINE_PRODUCTION_ANNUAL
artifacts.notes: Annual global mine production from the World Gold Council supply and demand dataset; units are tonnes.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_AISC_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly global average all-in sustaining cost (AISC) from the World Gold Council production costs dataset; units are US$/oz.

artifacts.name: GLOBAL_GOLD_AISC_ANNUAL
artifacts.notes: Annual average AISC derived as the simple mean of complete quarterly WGC AISC observations within each calendar year; units are US$/oz.

artifacts.name: OFFICIAL_GOLD_RESERVES_LATEST
artifacts.notes: Latest reported official gold reserve snapshot by country from the World Gold Council central bank dashboard. Fields include gold reserves in tonnes and US$ millions, FX reserves, total reserves, and gold holdings as a percent of total reserves. Data are monthly in source but represented here as the latest available cross-section.

artifacts.name: OFFICIAL_GOLD_RESERVES_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly country-level official gold reserve history from the public World Gold Council central bank dashboard API, including gold reserves in tonnes and US$ millions, FX reserves, total reserves, and gold holdings percent. The public API exposes quarterly and year-end history; monthly history is not publicly downloadable without login.

artifacts.name: CHANGE_IN_OFFICIAL_GOLD_RESERVES_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly change in reported official gold reserves by country, derived as the difference in tonnes from consecutive public WGC quarterly observations. Positive values indicate reported purchases and negative values indicate reported sales.

artifacts.name: GOLD_AS_PERCENT_OF_TOTAL_RESERVES_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly gold holdings as a percent of total reserves by country from the World Gold Council central bank dashboard API.

artifacts.name: REPORTED_CENTRAL_BANK_GOLD_PURCHASES_SALES_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly reported central bank gold purchases or sales by country, based on non-zero changes in official gold reserve tonnes between public WGC quarterly observations.

artifacts.name: OFFICIAL_GOLD_RESERVES_TONNES_QUARTERLY
artifacts.notes: Quarterly reported official gold reserves by country in tonnes from the World Gold Council central bank dashboard API.

artifacts.name: GLD_GOLD_OPTIONS_ATM_IV
artifacts.notes: Daily GLD option ATM implied volatility proxy derived from Nasdaq option-chain bid/ask prices with Black-Scholes inversion.

artifacts.name: GLD_GOLD_OPTIONS_25D_IV
artifacts.notes: Daily GLD option 25-delta implied volatility proxy derived from Nasdaq option-chain bid/ask prices and Black-Scholes deltas.
